title: 들은 말 전하기: 민수 씨가 좀 늦는대요
objective: By the end, you can choose the right form (-는대, -ㄴ대, -대, -았/었대) and use it to pass on news, messages and plans you heard from others.
summary: Learn the spoken ending -는대(요), a short form of -는다고 해(요), to pass on what someone else said.

task.title: Report what you heard
task.line: Change, choose, fix, or rewrite each sentence so it passes on someone else's words with -는대(요).

forms.when: Present or planned actions, when the verb stem ends in a consonant: 먹다 → 먹는대, 늦다 → 늦는대.
forms.means: Short for -는다고 해(요): 'They say / He says (someone) does…'
forms.example: 민수 씨가 오늘 회의에 좀 늦는대요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Minsu says he'll be a little late for the meeting today.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (가다 → 간대). With a ㄹ stem, drop ㄹ first (살다 → 산대).
forms.means: Short for -ㄴ다고 해(요): passing on what someone said they do or will do.
forms.example: 지수 씨는 요즘 회사 근처에 산대요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I heard Jisu lives near her office these days.

forms.when: Descriptions and states: 좋다 → 좋대, 비싸다 → 비싸대, 맛있다 → 맛있대.
forms.means: Short for -다고 해(요): 'They say it is…'
forms.example: 회사 앞 식당 김치찌개가 진짜 맛있대.
forms.exampleMeaning: People say the kimchi stew at the restaurant in front of the office is really good.

forms.when: Something that already happened, for both verbs and adjectives: 오다 → 왔대, 바쁘다 → 바빴대.
forms.exampleMeaning: I heard it snowed a lot in Busan yesterday.

watchOut: 맛있는대요 (X) → 맛있대요 (O): 있다 and 없다 also take -대 in this pattern.
놀는대요 (X) → 논대요 (O): For ㄹ verbs, drop ㄹ and add -ㄴ대. 아이들이 공원에서 논대요.
비가 온데요 (X) → 비가 온대요 (O): Write 대 (ㅐ) when you pass on someone's words. 온데요 is a common misspelling; -는데요 is a different ending (비가 오는데요 'It's raining, though…').
exercises: Fill in the blank with the -대요 form of the word in brackets: 형이 요즘 매일 아침 ____ (운동하다).
Fill in the blank with the -대요 form of the word in brackets: 그 드라마가 아주 ____ (재미있다).
Choose the correct form: ① 사장님이 오늘 좀 (바쁘는대요 / 바쁘대요). ② 수진 씨가 내일 회사에 (안 온대요 / 안 오는대요). ③ 동생이 생일 케이크를 직접 (만들는대 / 만든대).
Pass on Minho's message to your teacher with -대요: ① 민호: "어제 감기에 걸렸어요." ② 민호: "오늘 학원에 못 가요."
Find the mistake and fix it: 뉴스에서 내일은 날씨가 많이 춥는대요.
Make the sentence shorter with -대요: 마트가 이번 주말에 문을 닫는다고 해요.
answers: ① 바쁘대요 ② 안 온대요 ③ 만든대
① 민호 씨가 어제 감기에 걸렸대요. (어제 감기에 걸렸대요.) ② 민호 씨가 오늘 학원에 못 간대요. (오늘 학원에 못 간대요.)
춥는대요 → 춥대요: 뉴스에서 내일은 날씨가 많이 춥대요.
